dep_claim_scope.axiom_first_cl3_per_site_uniqueness_theo: Pure finite-dimensional algebra theorem: for real Cl(3,0), omega = gamma_1 gamma_2 gamma_3 is central with omega^2 = -1; Cl(3,0) tensor_R C splits as M_2(C) plus M_2(C) via the omega -> +/- i central-character summands; finite-dimensional complex representations decompose by Wedderburn/Schur into copies of the two 2-dimensional chiral simple modules. Physical per-site Hilbert-space identification, chirality selection, and downstream spin-statistics interpretation are excluded.
dep_claim_scope.cl3_complexification_split_narrow_theore: Pure abstract-algebra audit of (K1)-(K4) for Cl(3,0), its complexification, central idempotent split, and the resulting 2-dimensional irreducible complex modules; no physical Hilbert-space bridge audited.
dep_claim_scope.cl3_pauli_irrep_uniqueness_narrow_theore: Standalone finite-dimensional representation-theoretic theorem for real Cl(3,0): Pauli irreps exist, omega is central with omega^2 = -I, and the only faithful irreducible complex irreps are the two 2-dimensional chiralities.

previous_audits.claim_scope: Finite-group/character-theory audit of the binary octahedral group 2O: group order/centre/conjugacy structure, irrep dimension and z-sign partition, and the defining spin-1/2 representation's χ(-1)=-2, with no statistics or exchange claim.
previous_audits.load_bearing_step: The central element z=-1 is central of order 2, so by Schur's lemma it acts as a scalar ±1 on each irrep; the irreps that factor through O have z=+1 and the remaining spinorial irreps of dimensions {2,2,4} have z=-1, hence χ(z)=-dim.
previous_audits.notes_for_re_audit_if_any: A second auditor should re-check the numerical class-algebra clustering for accidental degeneracy, but the exact group/centre/defining-sign checks and standard 2O character table support the bounded conclusion.
previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The claim is a narrow algebraic finite-group statement, not a physical spin-statistics derivation. The runner constructs the 48 quaternion elements, checks closure, centre, conjugacy classes, and the defining SU(2) sign with exact symbolic arithmetic; it also checks the irrep dimension/sign partition by class-algebra eigenspace clustering against standard 2O character-table content. The cited internal authorities are retained-grade and are used only to identify the framework's per-site Cl(3) carrier, not to prove the finite-group facts. The note repeatedly excludes CAR, exchange, and spin-statistics, so the audited conclusion closes at ingredient B only.
